mapper.sql: select m.menu_id as "menuId", m.parent_menu_id as "parentMenuId", top.menu_name as "topMenuName", middle.menu_name as "middleMenuName", m.menu_name as "menuName", m.screen_id as "screenId", m.url as "url", coalesce(mus.system_use_yn, m.system_use_yn) as "systemUseYn", mus.exposure_start_at as "exposureStartAt", mus.exposure_end_at as "exposureEndAt", m.status as "status", mus.change_reason as "changeReason", mus.updated_by as "updatedBy", coalesce(mus.updated_at, m.updated_at) as "updatedAt" from menus m left join menu_usage_settings mus on mus.menu_id = m.menu_id left join menus middle on middle.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id left join menus top on top.menu_id = middle.parent_menu_id
mapper.select:
select count(*) from menus m left join menu_usage_settings mus on mus.menu_id = m.menu_id
m.status != 'DELETED' and m.url is not null
and (m.menu_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or m.screen_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or m.url ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%'))
and coalesce(mus.system_use_yn, m.system_use_yn) = #{criteria.systemUseYn}
select count(*) from menus where menu_id = #{menuId} and status != 'DELETED' and url is not null
mapper.insert: insert into menu_usage_settings (menu_id, system_use_yn, exposure_start_at, exposure_end_at, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{menuId}, #{systemUseYn}, #{exposureStartAt}, #{exposureEndAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{changeReason}) on conflict (menu_id) do update set system_use_yn = EXCLUDED.system_use_yn, exposure_start_at = EXCLUDED.exposure_start_at, exposure_end_at = EXCLUDED.exposure_end_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason
